summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py: checks loop/thread state, schedules a coroutine via asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe that sets the active app and calls the existing invoke helper on a partial, then blocks on the result. Thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) is initialized in the constructor and set/cleared in run's run_app coroutine around run_async in try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 10 tests; all pass on the venv's Python 3.9 when run with PYTHONPATH=src (the venv otherwise imports the base/ checkout). Nothing committed. Existing async test modules show 16 failures because the venv's pytest does not run async tests (asyncio_mode unknown); unrelated to this change and not verified against an unmodified run.
